overview.title: Today at a glance
overview.subtitle: What is waiting for the team.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Move each parcel to its next status. Every change is recorded with your name.

pickups.title: Pickups
pickups.subtitle: Scheduled pickups. Tick the orders the courier actually took; the rest go back to the merchant as new.
pickups.ordersInPickup: {count, plural, =0 {No orders attached} one {# order attached} other {# orders attached}}

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Changes that need a second person. You cannot approve a change you asked for yourself.

money.title: Money
money.subtitle: Close the day's cash, then prepare, approve and pay cash-outs. Approving needs a second person.
money.closeCyclesHint: Books the day's delivered cash and fees for every merchant. Safe to run again.
money.closedCycles: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing new to close} one {Closed # cash cycle} other {Closed # cash cycles}}
money.prepareHint: One cash-out per merchant whose payout day this is.
money.prepared: {created, plural, =0 {No new cash-outs} one {Prepared # cash-out} other {Prepared # cash-outs}}{skipped, plural, =0 {} one {, # merchant skipped} other {, # merchants skipped}}

support.title: Support
support.subtitle: Merchant tickets. Waiting ones come oldest first.
support.subject: Subject

errors.not_found: We could not find it. Refresh the page.
errors.invalid_transition: This order was already changed by someone else. Refresh the page.
errors.second_person_required: A second person must approve a change you asked for or prepared.
errors.not_pending: This was already handled. Refresh the page.
errors.not_prepared: This cash-out was already handled. Refresh the page.
errors.not_approved: This cash-out must be approved before it is paid.
errors.not_cancellable: This cash-out can no longer be canceled.
errors.pickup_not_collectable: This pickup is no longer scheduled.
errors.order_not_in_pickup: One of the orders is not in this pickup. Refresh the page.
